prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original hunting-game EQUIPMENT FAMILY concept art sheet, landscape 3:2, high detail. Reference 1 supplies approved restrained semi-real art direction; reference 2 supplies ONLY this creature's materials and distinctive anatomy. Do NOT show the creature itself. Warm ivory plain background, soft studio contact shadows, graphite-fine edges, matte leather, bone and restrained bronze joinery. No logos, no fantasy brand references, no Japanese text.
COMPOSITION: exactly ONE adult neutral mannequin wearing a COMPLETE FIVE-PIECE armor set, full body head to boots, standing at left 30% of sheet, empty relaxed hands, front three-quarter view with both shoulders readable. Helmet, chest armor, separate forearm gauntlets, waist armor, greaves all present. Practical low helmet, protected torso, no exposed midriff, no high heels, no cape. No anatomy deformities. At right 70%, exactly SEVEN clearly separated weapon GROUPS on a clean TWO ROW grid: top groups 01,02,03,04; bottom groups 05,06,07. Give all long weapons enough space; nothing clipped, overlapping, floating into adjacent groups or held by mannequin. Small plain labels 01 through 07 are the ONLY text.
GROUP TYPES (all seven mandatory): 01 thick broad single-edged greatblade with two-hand grip. 02 short SINGLE-EDGED sword AND separate shield. 03 long-handled maul with HARD CLOSED bone/stone faces, never a skin drum. 04 exactly TWO matching short twin blades. 05 ONE slender long curved single-edged blade. 06 ONE long STRAIGHT pointed lance AND separate broad shield. 07 ONE slender functional bow with a visible continuous string, small aiming ring near grip, AND ONE arrow. Bow is NOT a ring-shaped weapon.
Palette: 灰黒, 鈍赤銅, 煤灰.
Armor silhouette: 首の周囲へ低い四角い襟を巡らし、肩に短い匙形の板を置く。灰黒を主色に、襟の内縁だけ鈍い赤銅色にする。
Armor parts: {"head": "低い四角襟に収まる小さな兜。四隅は丸め、頭頂は平らにする。", "chest": "灰黒の胸衣に四角い灼襟を低く巡らし、内縁だけ赤銅色へする。", "arms": "肩に短い匙形板、前腕に灰匙翼骨の細い甲を付ける。", "waist": "煤寄せ羽を短い四角い腰房へ並べ、前と横の隙間を空ける。", "legs": "細い羽鞘を脛へ伏せ、膝の丸甲と足甲を別々に留める。"}
Exact weapon material/shape directions, in group order: ["低い四角灼襟を刃の根元へ組み込み、匙翼骨を幅広い峰へ使う。両手で握る長い柄と幅広い片刃。刃先・刃面を明確にし、厚さだけで重量感を出す。", "四角い刃元の片刃と、四辺の内縁が赤銅色の小盾。短い片刃剣と独立した盾の一組。盾には背面の握りと前腕帯を備える。", "四角灼襟の硬い骨枠を二つの平打面で閉じた角槌。長柄と閉じた硬い二つの打面。膜や嚢を打面として露出しない。", "四角い刃元と匙形の反りを持つ同形短刀二本。同じ長さ・同じ輪郭の短い片刃二本。手首を塞ぐ鉤や長い飾り紐を付けない。", "灰匙翼骨を長く継ぎ、四角い小鍔の内側に熱脂羽鞘を収める。細い長刀と緩い反り、握りの余長。刃を片側へ限定し、峰を低く保つ。", "灼襟枠の中心から伸びる直槍と、四辺の低い熱逃がしを持つ盾。真っ直ぐな長槍と独立した大盾の一組。穂先を小さく、握りと前腕の空間を残す。", "匙翼骨を上下対称に割った弓身。熱脂羽鞘は握りの四角い覆いへ使う。細い上下対称の弓身、一本の弦、握りのすぐ上の小さい照準環、矢一本。環を巨大化しない。"]
Use material-derived structural forms, not giant animal heads as helmets. Keep decorated projections low and joints free. Keep weapons functional, blade edges distinct from the spine, no repeated generic swords. This is a native-rank family concept board, NOT an orthographic diagram or a battle scene. Never add large glow halos, particle effects, monsters, extra people, extra weapons or unrelated scenery.
CRITICAL TEXT RULE: Do not typeset any title, header, species name, rank, palette words, Japanese description, swatches or captions. Only the seven small numeric labels 01 through 07 may appear. Use the full canvas for the objects.
FRAMING REQUIREMENT: Place every object inside the inner 85 percent of the canvas. Leave a generous visible empty ivory margin on all four edges, at least 80 pixels in a 1536x1024 image. The tallest sword tip, spear tip, bow limbs, feet and arrow tips must be fully inside this safe margin. Scale down objects slightly to ensure no clipping. All seven groups and full body are mandatory.
